picks.body: Patrick put Matthew Golden in a flex spot and got 19.4 in a 10.14-point win over Moe. Michael Wilson, a same-position bench option, scored 5.2. Replacing Golden with Wilson would have turned the win into a 4.06-point loss. The quarterback supplied only 4.48; this is where Nix in 5 found room to survive. Retrospective credit for the result, not a claim that the choice was obvious before lock.

Pitts in that slot produces a 109.82–91.70 hypothetical win. This is completed-week arithmetic, not evidence about availability, information or reasonable expectations before lock.
